title: Centered weighted sum formula
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\\in\\mathbb R$, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{0,1\\}$. Its Fourier coefficient, computed using the real-valued version of $f$, minus $p$ when $S$ is empty and minus zero otherwise, equals the sum over all cube points $x$ of $\\frac{\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i}{2^n}(f(x)-p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
$f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube with values in $\\{0,1\\}$
